original: upāsya brahma upāsiturātmatvenopāsyam | upāsitā pratyagātmā svaśarīrasya svayaṃ yathā ātmā; tathā paraṃ brahma svātmano'pyātmeti, upāsyaṃ brahma ātmetyevopāsīta sarvasya cida- cidvastunaḥ, 'sarva khalvidaṃ brahma tajjalāniti, tajjatvāt tallatvāt tadanatvāt tanniyāmyatvāt taccharīratvācca, sarvasya ayaṃ ( paramātmā) ātmā |
analyzed: upāsya brahma upāsituḥ ātma tvena upāsyam upāsitā pratyagātmā sva śarīrasya svayam yathā ātmā tathā param brahma sva ātmanā upi ātmā iti upāsyam brahma ātmā iti eva upāsīta sarvasya cit a cit vastunaḥ sarva khalu idam brahma tat jalāniti tad ja tvāt tad la tvāt tad anatvāt tad niyāmya tvāt tad śarīra tvāt ca sarvasya ayam paramātmā ātmā

original: yathā svaśarīraṃ prati pratyamātmana ātmatvāt 'devoshaṃ, manuṣyo'ham' ityanusandhānam ; tathā paramātmanaḥ pratyagātmano'pyātmatvāt, tasyāpi 'aham' ityeva anusandhāna yuktamiti ||
analyzed: yathā sva śarīram prati pratyamātmanaḥ ātma tvāt devaḥ ūham manuṣyaḥ ūham iti anusandhānam tathā paramātmanaḥ pratyagātmanā upi ātma tvāt tasya api aham iti eva anusandhāna yuktam iti

original: evaṃ śāstrairupapāditaṃ sarvabuddhīnāṃ brahmakaniṣṭhatvena sarvaśabdānāṃ brahmakaniṣṭhatvam abhyupa. gacchantaḥ, 'tvaṃ vā ahamasmi bhagavo devate ! ahaṃ vai tvamasi bhagavo devate ! ' iti vyati kareṇoktavantaḥ ||
analyzed: evam śāstraiḥ upapāditam sarva buddhīnām brahma kaniṣṭha tvena sarva śabdānām brahma kaniṣṭha tvam abhyupa gacchantaḥ tvam vai aham asmi bhagavaḥ devate aham vai tvam asi bhagavaḥ devate iti vyati kareṇa uktavantaḥ

original: evaṃ capā ātmetyevopāsīta' iti | 'atmatvā nanusandhā niṣeva, 'pṛthagātmānaṃ preritāraṃ ca matvā' iti pṛthatvānusandhānavidhānaṃ ca aviruddham | 'aham ' iti svātmatayā anusandhānāt, 'atha yaḥ anyāṃ devatāmupāste....na sa veda' iti anyatvānusandhāna- niṣedho rakṣitaḥ |
analyzed: evam ātmā iti eva upāsīta iti pṛthak ātmānam preritāram ca matvā iti pṛthatva anusandhāna vidhānam ca aviruddham aham iti sva ātma tayā anusandhānāt atha yaḥ anyām devatām upāstena sa veda iti anya tva anusandhāna niṣedhaḥ rakṣitaḥ

original: straśarīrā svātmano'dhikatvānusandhānavat, svātmano'pi ( sakāśāt ) paramātmanaḥ adhikatvānusandhānāt pṛthaktvānusandhānavidhānaṃ ca rakṣitam ||
analyzed: stra śarīrā sva ātmanā adhika tva anusandhāna vat sva ātmanaḥ api sakāśāt paramātmanaḥ adhika tva anusandhānāt pṛthaktva anusandhāna vidhānam ca rakṣitam

original: adhikasya brahmaṇaḥ pratyagātmana ātmatvāt tasya ca brahmaśarīratvāt niṣedhakavākye 'akṛtsno hyeṣa : ' ityuktam | ataḥ upāsiturātmatvena brahma upāsyam - iti sthitam ||
analyzed: adhikasya brahmaṇaḥ pratyagātmanaḥ ātma tvāt tasya ca brahma śarīra tvāt niṣedhaka vākye akṛtsnaḥ hi eṣa iti uktam atas upāsituḥ ātma tvena brahma upāsyam iti sthitam

original: 'mano brahmetyupāsīta' 'nāma brahmetyupaste ' ityādipratikopāsaneṣu, pratīke na ātma- tvānusandhānaṃ kāryam | na hi upāsiturātmā pratīkaḥ | pratīkopāsaneṣu, pratīka evopāsya: ; na brahma | brahma tu tatra dṛṣṭiviśeṣaṇamātram | pratīkopāsanaṃ hi nāma - abrahmaṇi brahmadṛṣṭyā'nu- sandhānam |
analyzed: manaḥ brahma iti upāsīta nāma brahma iti upaste ityādi pratika upāsaneṣu pratīke na ātma tva anusandhānam kāryam na hi upāsituḥ ātmā pratīkaḥ pratīka upāsaneṣu pratīkaḥ eva upāsya na brahma brahma tu tatra dṛṣṭi viśeṣaṇa mātram pratīka upāsanam hi nāma abrahmaṇi brahma dṛṣṭyā anu sandhānam

original: tatra upāsyasya pratīkasya upāsiturātmatvābhāvāt, na tathā'nusandheyam ||
analyzed: tatra upāsyasya pratīkasya upāsituḥ ātma tva abhāvāt na tathā anusandheyam

original: ādityādīnāmeva ( udvīthādyapekṣayā) utkṛṣṭatvopapatteḥ, ṛtvaṅge udgīthādau ādityā- didṛṣṭaya eva kāryā: ; ( na tu udgīthādidṛṣṭirādityādau ) | ādispādidevatārādhanadvāreṇa hi karmaṇāmapi phalasādhanatvam ||

original: mokṣasādhanatayā vedāntaśāstrairvihitaṃ dhyānopāsanādiśabdavācyaṃ jñānam asakṛdāvṛtta- smṛtisantatirūpam āsīnaḥ anutiṣṭhet | āsīnasyaiva hi ekāgracittatāsambhava: ; sthiti- gatyoḥ prayatnasāpekṣatvāt, śayāne ca nidrāsambhavāt | paścārdhadhāraṇaprayatnanivṛttaye sāpāśraye āsīnaḥ kuryāt ||
analyzed: mokṣa sādhanatayā vedānta śāstraiḥ vihitam dhyāna upāsana ādi śabda vācyam jñānam asakṛt āvṛtta smṛti santati rūpam āsīnaḥ anutiṣṭhet āsīnasya eva hi ekāgra citta tā sambhava sthiti gatyoḥ prayatna sāpekṣa tvāt śayāne ca nidrā sambhavāt paśca ardha dhāraṇa prayatna nivṛttaye sa apāśraye āsīnaḥ kuryāt

original: upāsanasya dhyānarūpatvāt ekāgracittatā avaśyaṃbhāvinī | dhyānaṃ hi vijātīya- pratyayāntarāvyahitam eka cintanam | ekāgracittatayā niścalatvam (pṛthivī - parvatādivat ) āsī- nasyaiva upāsakasya sambhavet || smaranti ca āsītasyaiva dhyānam -'śucau deśe .... ekāgraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā .... upaviśyāsane yujjyādyogamātmaviśuddhaye' iti ||
analyzed: upāsanasya dhyāna rūpa tvāt ekāgra citta tā avaśyaṃbhāvinī dhyānam hi vijātīya pratyaya antara avyahitam eka cintanam ekāgra citta tayā niścala tvam pṛthivī parvata ādi vat upāsakasya sambhavet smaranti ca āsītasya eva dhyānam śucau deśe ekāgram manaḥ kṛtvā upaviśya āsane yujjyāt yogam ātma viśuddhaye iti

original: ekāgratātirikta deśakālaviśeṣā- śravaṇāt, ekāgratānukūlo yo deśaḥ kālaśca sa eva upāsanasya (yogyaḥ ) deśaḥ kālaśca | 'mano'nukūle' iti vākyaśeṣāt ||
analyzed: śravaṇāt ekāgratā anukūlaḥ yaḥ deśaḥ kālaḥ ca saḥ eva upāsanasya yogyaḥ deśaḥ kālaḥ ca manaḥ nukūle iti vākyaśeṣāt

original: śaktirapi paramapuruṣāprītireva | tadevaṃ vidyā, vedituḥ vedyātyaryapriyatvena svayamapi nirati- śayapriyā satī, vedyabhūtaparamapuruṣārādhanasvarūpā, pūrvakṛtāghasaṃcayajanitaparamapuruṣāprītiṃ vināśayati | saiva vidyā svotpatyuttarakālabhāvyagha nimittaparamapuruṣāprītyutpatti ca pratibadhnāti ||
analyzed: śaktiḥ api paramapuruṣa aprītiḥ eva tat evam vidyā vedituḥ vedyā atyarya priya tvena svayam api nirati śaya priyā satī vedya bhūta paramapuruṣa ārādhana svarūpā pūrva kṛta agha saṃcaya janita paramapuruṣa aprītim vināśayati sā eva vidyā sva utpati uttara kāla bhāvi agha nimitta paramapuruṣa aprīti utpatti ca pratibadhnāti

original: uktena nyāyena puṇyasyāpi vidyayā aśleṣa - vināśau syātām; vidyāphalavirodhitva- sāmānyāt, 'sarve pāpmāno'to nivartante' iti, sukṛtasyā'pi pāpmaśabdena vyapadeśāt || mumukṣoraniṣṭaphalatvāt, sukṛtasya 'pi pāpmaśabdena vyapadeśa: || śarīrapātādūrdhvaṃ tu vidyānu- guṇadṛṣṭaphalāni sukṛtāni naśyantīti ||
analyzed: uktena nyāyena puṇyasya api vidyayā aśleṣa vināśau syātām vidyā phala virodhi tva sāmānyāt sarve pāpmānaḥ utas nivartante iti sukṛtasya api pāpma śabdena vyapadeśāt mumukṣoḥ aniṣṭa phala tvāt sukṛtasya pāpma śabdena vyapadeśa śarīrapātāt ūrdhvam tu vidyā anu guṇa dṛṣṭa phalāni sukṛtāni naśyanti iti

original: vidyotpatteḥ pūrve sukṛta- duṣkṛte, apravṛttaphale eva vidyayā naśyataḥ, aviśeṣeṇa | 'tasya tāvadeva ciraṃ yāvanna vimokṣye, atha sampatsye iti śarīrapātavilambāvaghitvaśruteḥ | na ca puṇyāpuṇyakarmajanyabhagavatprīttivyatirekeṇa śarīra sthitihetubhūtasaṃskārasadbhāve pramāṇamasti ||
analyzed: vidyā utpatteḥ pūrve sukṛta duṣkṛte apravṛtta phale eva vidyayā naśyataḥ aviśeṣeṇa tasya tāvat eva ciram yāvat na vimokṣye atha sampatsye iti śarīrapāta vilamba avaghi tva śruteḥ na ca puṇya apuṇya karma janya bhagavat prītti vyatirekeṇa śarīra sthiti hetu bhūta saṃskāra sadbhāve pramāṇam asti

original: agnihotrādyāśramadharmā phalāśleṣāsambhavāt anuṣṭheyā eva | vidyā khyakāryāyaiva viduṣaḥ agnihotrādyanuṣṭhānamiti teṣāṃ tatkāryārthatvāt tada ( phalā) śleṣāsambhavaḥ | dṛśyate hi agnihotrādīnāṃ vidyāsādhanatvam, tametaṃ vedānuvacanena' ityādinā ||
analyzed: agnihotra ādi āśrama dharmā phala āśleṣa asambhavāt anuṣṭheyāḥ eva vidyā khya kāryāya eva viduṣaḥ agnihotra ādi anuṣṭhānam iti teṣām tad kārya artha tvāt śleṣa asambhavaḥ dṛśyate hi agnihotra ādīnām vidyā sādhana tvam tam etam veda anuvacanena ityādinā

original: āprayāṇāt abhyāsādheyātiśayāyāḥ vidyāyāśca aharaharutpādyatvāt, tadutpattyartham āśramakarmā'pi aharaharanuṣṭheyameva | anyathā āśramakarmalope, dūṣitāntaḥkaraṇasya vidyotpattireva na syāt ||
analyzed: āprayāṇāt abhyāsa ādheya atiśayāyāḥ vidyāyāḥ ca ahar ahar utpādya tvāt tad utpatti artham āśrama karma api ahar ahar anuṣṭheyam eva anyathā āśrama karma lope dūṣita antaḥkaraṇasya vidyā utpattiḥ eva na syāt

original: tadevaṃ brahmavidyāyāḥ prāganuṣṭhitam abhuktaphalam anārabdhaphalaṃ puṇya-pāparūpaṃ karma anādikālasañcitam anantam, vidyāmāhātmyādvinaśyati | vidyārambhottara kālamanuṣṭhitaṃ ca, na śliṣyati | tatra puṇyarūpaṃ sarva, viduṣaḥ suhṛdo gṛhṇanti | pāpaṃ ca dviṣantaḥ iti niravadyam ||
analyzed: tat evam brahma vidyāyāḥ prāc anuṣṭhitam abhukta phalam anārabdha phalam puṇya pāpa rūpam karma anādi kāla sañcitam anantam vidyā māhātmyāt vinaśyati vidyā ārambha uttara kālam anuṣṭhitam ca na śliṣyati tatra puṇya rūpam sarva viduṣaḥ suhṛdaḥ gṛhṇanti pāpam ca dviṣantaḥ iti niravadyam

original: puruṣasya prayataḥ vāṅmanasi sampadyate ' iti vāco manasi sampattiśrutiḥ, vāk- svarūpasya manasi sampattāveva upapadyate ; na vṛttimātrasampattau | manasā vāk saṃyujyate; na tu tatra līyate | manasaḥ vākprakṛtikatvābhāvāt ||
analyzed: puruṣasya prayataḥ vāc manasi sampadyate iti vācaḥ manasi sampatti śrutiḥ vāc svarūpasya manasi sampattau eva upapadyate na vṛtti mātra sampattau manasā vāc saṃyujyate na tu tatra līyate manasaḥ vāc prakṛtika tva abhāvāt

original: ( tathaiḥ ) sarvendriyasaṃyuktaṃ manaḥ prāṇe saṃyujyate; na manovṛttimātram | 'manaḥ prāṇe' iti vākyāt ||
analyzed: tathaiḥ sarva indriya saṃyuktam manaḥ prāṇe saṃyujyate na manaḥ vṛtti mātram manaḥ prāṇe iti vākyāt

original: sa ca prāṇaḥ karaṇādhipe jītre sampadyate |
analyzed: sa ca prāṇaḥ karaṇa adhipe jītre sampadyate

original: jīvasaṃyuktasya prāṇasya tejasi sampatti:, sarveṣu bhūteṣu; jīvasya saṃcarataḥ sarvabhūta- mayatvabhūteḥ ||
analyzed: jīva saṃyuktasya prāṇasya tejasi sarveṣu bhūteṣu jīvasya saṃcarataḥ sarva bhūta maya tva bhūteḥ

original: iyam utkrāntiḥ nāḍīpraveśanāt prāk vidvadaviduṣoḥ samānā | tatpraveśadaśāyāṃ ca viśeṣaḥ śrūyate | mūrdhnā niṣkramaṇaṃ vidvadviṣayam : 'atra brahma samaśnute' iti ca upāsanavelāyāṃ yo brahmānubhavaḥ, tadviṣayam ||
analyzed: iyam utkrāntiḥ nāḍī praveśanāt prāk vidvat aviduṣoḥ samānā tad praveśa daśāyām ca viśeṣaḥ śrūyate mūrdhnā niṣkramaṇam vidvat viṣayam atra brahma samaśnute iti ca upāsana velāyām yaḥ brahma anubhavaḥ tad viṣayam

original: vidvān, śatādhikayā mūrdhanyayā nāḍyaiva utkrāmati | vidvān hi paramapuruṣārādhana- bhūtātyarthatriyavidyāsāmarthyāt vidyāśeṣabhūtiyā ātmanotyartha priyagatya nummaraṇayogācca prasannena hārdena paramapuruṣeṇa anugṛhīto bhavati | tataśca tasya jīvasya sthānaṃ hṛdayam agrajvalanaṃ bhavati |
